description: Get the US district-court infringement litigation history for a patent: who sued whom, in which court, over what (cause of action), with filing dates. Backed by the USPTO Patent Litigation Dataset. Coverage: comprehensive 2003-2016, partial to 2020 (no cases after 2020). Empty result = not litigated on record. Free, public-record.

limit.description: Max cases to return (default: all stored).

name: litigation

cases.description: District-court cases (case number, court, date, name, plaintiffs, defendants, cause).

truncated.description: Whether the case list was truncated by the limit.
